purpose: Explicit reviewed readiness bindings for legacy and current producer source IDs; bindings do not rewrite canonical source provenance or confer evidence rank.

The active JRA 30-day discovery and programme parser use the reviewed JRA calendar/programme family. This readiness alias does not rewrite canonical source provenance.
The active combined NAR monthly discovery/RaceList producer uses the reviewed fourteen-venue RaceList/DebaTable family; accepted evidence still determines meeting rank.

The reviewed TJK readiness record explicitly covers annual fixture discovery and current daily programme acquisition, with the existing public ceiling retained.
